items.question: My cousin lives in ___ Netherlands.
explanations: This plural name needs 'the', unlike France.
Correct! Plural country names take 'the': 'the Netherlands'.

items.question: We took a boat down ___ Amazon.
She's studying in ___ Japan this year.
explanations: Correct! Most countries take no article: 'Japan'.

items.question: They climbed ___ Mount Everest.
explanations: Single mountains don't take 'the' (but ranges do).
Correct! Single mountains take no article: 'Mount Everest'.

items.question: We hiked in ___ Alps last summer.
The tour includes ___ British Museum.
explanations: Correct! Institutions with a common noun take 'the': 'the British Museum'.

items.question: He flew into ___ Heathrow Airport.
explanations: Correct! Airports named after a place take no article: 'Heathrow Airport'.

items.question: She graduated from ___ University of Cambridge.
Choose the correct version of: 'We sailed across Pacific.'
Which type of name takes 'the'?
explanations: Single lakes take no article (Lake Como).
Correct! Rivers, seas and ranges take 'the' (the Nile, the Alps).

items.question: They visited ___ Alps last winter.
items.explanation: Mountain ranges have plural names and take 'the': the Alps.

common.why: 'Alps' is a plural name, so it takes 'the'.

items.question: She studies at University of Oxford.
answers: She studies at the University of Oxford
items.explanation: Names built with 'of' take 'the': the University of Oxford.

items.question: She lives in the France.
items.explanation: Most single country names take no article: France.
